subject.title: Newport-Mesa Unified School District Board, Trustee Area 7

text: I am a proud Newport-Mesa Unified alum and lifelong Westside Costa Mesa resident, and I am honored and excited for the opportunity to serve as your Board of Education Trustee for Area 7. I attended Whittier Elementary, Ensign Intermediate, and Newport Harbor High. The first in my family to attend college, I chose a career in public service that allows me to give back to the community that shaped me.

I worked for five years for NMUSD and understand our school district facilities and operations. I have now worked for 18 years with the City of Costa Mesa (including roles with Parks and Community Services, City Clerk’s office, and Code Enforcement) through which I have developed broad community relationships and a deep understanding of how government works including budgets, processes, and partnerships. I know how to get things done while staying rooted in our community and finding ways to open doors and uplift others.
Throughout my life, I have remained active in youth development and local leadership:

Board Member - Leadership Tomorrow
Board Member - Costa Mesa City Employee Association
Youth Mentor - Bright Youth
Youth Sports Coach and Program Volunteer Lead - MIKA CDC
Volunteer - Think Together, Love Costa Mesa, and CM Mutual Aid

My personal and professional experience combined with longstanding community relationships and passion for serving our neighborhood makes me uniquely qualified to be your Board Trustee. When homegrown community leaders are present and engaged, young people feel more empowered to believe in themselves. As someone who has walked in their shoes, overcome challenges, and paved my own path, I want to empower and support our students to do the same.

This year, our daughter will start her education in Newport-Mesa. My wife and I are determined that she and her Westside CM peers have better access to high quality education, best-in-class facilities, and enriching extracurricular opportunities that inspire them to dream. Having attended schools in both Westside Costa Mesa and Newport Beach, I have seen the disparities in facilities and resources firsthand. I want to meet that challenge head on with out-of-the-box solutions. I’ll partner hand-in-hand with our parents, teachers, administrators, and community organizations to make sure every student is given an opportunity to thrive.
I’m honored to continue serving the community that shaped me. I’m ready to help all NMUSD students achieve their full potential.
I ask for your support and your vote.

text: I am running for the Newport-Mesa Unified School District Board of Education to advocate for student achievement, support our outstanding teachers, and strengthen the partnership between schools and families. I will work to ensure parents have access to the information, resources, and opportunities they need to actively support their children’s education.

As a bilingual member of our community, I will help expand meaningful engagement with families who have historically faced challenges accessing school resources due to language barriers, while celebrating the diverse cultures and experiences that make NMUSD stronger.

I believe every child deserves excellent educational opportunities and every family deserves to feel connected, respected, and empowered. I would be honored to bring my experience as an educator, business owner, and Spanish-speaking community leader to the NMUSD Board of Education.”
I have dedicated my career to connecting people through language and education.

My priorities are
To help children achieve their career and college dreams. Provide excellent programs in math, science, technology and the arts
provide every student and every family with the opportunity to fully participate and succeed.
As a bilingual educator, entrepreneur, and proud immigrant from Lima, Peru, I have experienced first hand the power of language, education, and community.
